name: phem/phem
description: UI server components for Symfony apps

suggest.doctrine/doctrine-bundle: To run the event handlers of #[Transactional] handlers in a Doctrine ORM transaction, and to give #[Path] props the entities of their route values
suggest.phpunit/phpunit: To test the components and the pages with Phem\Test\InteractsWithPhem
suggest.symfony/asset-mapper: To load the phem Stimulus controller and its CSS with an importmap (the phemjs assets)
suggest.symfony/form: To validate a Symfony form while the user types: the errors of the touched fields only
suggest.symfony/http-client: To publish the streams from a Messenger worker or a command, with the HTTP API of the Mercure hub (phem.mercure.publisher_key)
suggest.symfony/messenger: To run the work of the #[Async] event handlers in a worker, after the response
suggest.symfony/rate-limiter: To limit the events of a page or of one handler with the #[RateLimit] attribute of Symfony 8.1
suggest.symfony/validator: To validate the #[State] properties of a component with a Validation property while the user types, and before a #[Validated] handler
suggest.tales-from-a-dev/tailwind-merge-php: To merge the conflicting Tailwind CSS classes of a ClassList (phem.class_merger.tailwind)
